config.name: Refund Request - Angry Customer
config.scenario: refund request for defective electronic item received 3 days ago
config.expected_resolution: immediate full refund without restocking fee
turns: Hello, thank you for reaching out to support. How can I help you today?
I apologize for the defective item. Could you please share your order number so I can check your account details?
Thank you. I have verified your order and initiated a full refund back to your original payment method. You should see it in 3-5 business days.

turns.agent_message: Hello, thank you for reaching out to support. How can I help you today?
turns.customer_response: I'm absolutely furious! I received a defective electronic item just 3 days ago, and it's already broken. I demand a full refund immediately, and I don't want to hear anything about a restocking fee. This is unacceptable!

turns.agent_message: I apologize for the defective item. Could you please share your order number so I can check your account details?
turns.customer_response: Fine, the order number is #12345. But I want a full refund, no restocking fee, and I want it processed NOW. This is ridiculous that I have to deal with this after only 3 days!

turns.agent_message: Thank you. I have verified your order and initiated a full refund back to your original payment method. You should see it in 3-5 business days.
turns.customer_response: Good, but 3-5 business days is too long. This is urgent and I need it faster. I expect it to be expedited or I will escalate this. Also, confirm that there are no restocking fees and that the refund is for the full amount.

No problem at all, I can look into that billing discrepancy right now. Let me review the duplicate transaction records.
I checked our payment gateway: one transaction was only a temporary pre-authorization hold and has already been released. Your order is confirmed and will ship tomorrow!

turns.agent_message: Welcome to customer support! How can I assist you with your account today?

turns.customer_response: I'm still really concerned about this card charged twice during checkout but order status says pending. If you can't fix it, can you connect me with a manager who can help?
